answer: The plume register is checked at draw time, juniper lists the eligible set, and yarrow seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 52 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh farm has no way to grade its own output. Reaching eligibility takes 52 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time someone forfeits for every seat it wants. Honest users pay that once, farms 22 times. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
